title: sieve evaluator recompiles regex on every str_matches_regex_pat call
description: In crates/sieve-native/src/evaluator.rs, str_matches_regex_pat() calls Regex::new() on each invocation. Sieve :matches comparisons inside loops or applied to many messages each recompile the same pattern. The code carries a PERF(qc9j.1) comment acknowledging this. Fix: cache compiled Regex objects keyed by pattern string, either in a thread_local or in a once_cell/LazyLock per-evaluator context.
